name: 2,4,6-TMPEA-NBOMe
summary: 2,4,6-TMPEA-NBOMe, also known as ψ-2C-O-NBOMe or 26O-NBOMe as well as N-(2-methoxybenzyl)-2,4,6-trimethoxyphenethylamine, is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine, ψ-PEA, and N-benzylphenethylamine (NBOMe) families. It is the NBOMe derivative of ψ-2C-O (2,4,6-TMPEA). The drug is said to produce psychedelic effects such as visuals.7 nM and an EmaxTooltip maximal efficacy of 49%.

pharmacology.text: It has been found to act as a potent serotonin 5-HT2A receptor partial agonist, with an EC50 of 1.7 nM and an Emax of 49%.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its family, the NBOMes, are active in tiny amounts, which makes accidental overdose easy. They have caused seizures, overheating, a racing heart, kidney damage and deaths.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。同族的NBOMe類藥物極微量即有作用，因此很容易意外過量。它們曾造成癲癇發作、體溫過高、心跳急促、腎臟損傷與死亡。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。同族的NBOMe类药物极微量即有作用，因此很容易意外过量。它们曾造成癫痫发作、体温过高、心跳急促、肾脏损伤与死亡。

fact.en: The NBOMe part of its name is a 2-methoxybenzyl group added to the nitrogen, a change that can make phenethylamine psychedelics far more potent.
fact.zh: 名稱中的NBOMe是加在氮上的2-甲氧基苄基，這個改變能讓苯乙胺類迷幻藥的效力大幅提高。
fact.zhHans: 名称中的NBOMe是加在氮上的2-甲氧基苄基，这个改变能让苯乙胺类迷幻药的效力大幅提高。
